competitions.prizeName: Three R5,000 grocery vouchers

competitions.eligibility: Grades 8–12, under 18 at entry, registered South African school or home-school institution, written guardian consent; Media24 and recent-winner exclusions apply.

Open the embedded entry form on the official News24 competition page. Provide the learner and guardian details, artwork photo or scan and required consent declarations.
Submit one complete entry before 23:59 on 30 October. Keep a copy of the artwork and consent.

competitions.title: MTN and Algoa FM Big Walk: Cash and Home Internet Prizes

competitions.eligibility: South African citizens aged 18+ residing within Algoa FM’s broadcast region, with a valid South African ID or passport and a South African bank account in their own name. entrySteps: Read the MTN campaign PDF and linked Algoa FM standard rules, including the regional, identity, citizenship, bank-account and previous-win requirements.

Base entry is open to customers of any mobile network without an MTN recharge. To claim the optional R2,000 weekly bonus, an MTN customer must provide proof of a recent qualifying R50 recharge, verified by MTN.

Be available for the Breakfast call. Weekly competition moments take place on 16, 23 and 30 October; a missed call forfeits the selection. The separate grand prize is announced on 31 October, after entries close.

Find the new Pass the Parcel competition post published each Monday and tag a friend in that post’s comments. Extra friend tags provide extra entries.
Return to the new post the following week; follow the current weekly post’s instructions. Facebook and Instagram entries feed one daily draw.
Check Friday announcements and direct-message requests. Winners collect vouchers at their chosen Gelmar store during November after being notified.

entrySteps: Follow ERA's official Facebook or Instagram account.
Take eligible e-waste to a participating official ERA collection point and place it into the correct bin safely.
Photograph the genuine disposal event without climbing into or interfering with the bin, then send the photo to ERA by direct message on the platform used to enter.

competitions.title: FOUR PAWS Paws For a Cause Raffle 2026
competitions.summary: Buy a R100 Paws For a Cause raffle ticket for a chance to win a cash prize in one of FOUR PAWS South Africa's four-monthly draws.
competitions.prizeName: R25,000 cash per four-month draw, subject to a lower prize formula if fewer than 1,000 tickets are sold
competitions.eligibility: South African residents aged 18 or older, excluding FOUR PAWS directors, staff and their immediate family members.
entrySteps: Read the full official FOUR PAWS raffle terms and confirm that paid entry suits your budget.
Complete the official sign-up form and buy one or more R100 raffle tickets through the FOUR PAWS donation site.
Keep the issued unique ticket number and current contact details for the relevant four-month draw.

competitions.title: Builders Ratings and Reviews Competition 2026
competitions.summary: Buy a product online from Builders and submit a review through the follow-up email for a chance to win one of five monthly R1,000 vouchers. Runs to 31 December 2026.
competitions.prizeName: A R1,000 Builders voucher
competitions.eligibility: South African citizens, temporary residents or permanent residents aged 18 or older with the specified ID or passport and residency documents. Promoter-related parties are excluded.
entrySteps: Make a qualifying online product purchase from Builders.
Use the review link in the email sent after your purchase and submit your own product review.
A new purchased product is required for each additional entry. Returning the product withdraws its entry.
Submit reviews during the stated 07:00–18:00 entry hours rather than relying on the later online-purchase cutoff.

competitions.title: Clicks Energizer: Win R5,000 ClubCard Cashback
competitions.summary: Buy two Energizer products in one transaction and swipe your Clicks ClubCard for a chance to win one of ten R5,000 ClubCard cashback prizes.
competitions.prizeName: R5,000 Clicks ClubCard cashback
competitions.eligibility: South African residents aged 18 or older who belong to Clicks ClubCard and make the qualifying purchase. Clicks, its promotion agencies, the supplier and their specified related parties are excluded.
entrySteps: Be a Clicks ClubCard member aged 18 or older and resident in South Africa.
Buy two Energizer products in a single transaction at a South African Clicks store and swipe your ClubCard. Online purchases meeting the same criteria also qualify.
Entry is automatic when you meet the conditions; keep your ClubCard contact details current.
Complete your qualifying transaction between 2026-10-01 and 2026-12-31. The rules do not state a closing hour.
If selected, respond within two working days of contact and provide the required identity evidence.

competitions.title: Oxford Freshmarket: Win a Share of R500,000
competitions.summary: Buy a marked participating product and swipe Oxford Rewards for a chance to win a share of R500,000. Finalists must attend the early-2027 draw event.
competitions.prizeName: R500,000 across eight prizes: R250,000, R150,000, R50,000 and five R10,000 prizes
competitions.eligibility: 18+ SA citizen/permanent resident with valid ID or proof of permanent residency.
entrySteps: Find a participating Weekly Deals product displaying the Win Half a Million icon at Oxford.
Buy it and swipe your Oxford Rewards card at the till to record entry.
Complete the qualifying transaction by 31 December 2026. If selected as a finalist, attend the final draw event; its date is still to be confirmed.

competitions.title: PlayGolf Parys: Win a Srixon ZXi RKT Driver
competitions.summary: Book, pay for your own seat and score a round at Parys in PlayGolf for a driver draw. Entries close at 1,000 valid entries or 31 December, whichever comes first.
competitions.prizeName: One Srixon ZXi RKT driver; promoter-stated value R10,999.99
competitions.eligibility: 18+ SA residents with SA ID/passport and own-name PlayGolf account/phone.
entrySteps: Book a 9- or 18-hole Parys round in your own PlayGolf account and pay for your own seat through the app.
Play and score every hole; finish the card by 23:59 that day, linked to your account.
Complete all entry steps before 23:59 SA time on 31 December 2026 or the 1,000-entry cap. One entry per round, maximum one per person per day.

competitions.title: Dis-Chem Energizer: Win R5,000 Better Rewards
competitions.summary: Buy two Energizer products in store and swipe Dis-Chem Better Rewards for a chance to win R5,000 in reward credit. Ten prizes; purchase required.
competitions.prizeName: 10 prizes of R5,000 in Dis-Chem Better Rewards
competitions.eligibility: SA legal residents/citizens over 18 with valid ID; previous six-month Dis-Chem winners excluded.
entrySteps: Buy any two Energizer products in a Dis-Chem store during the campaign.
Swipe your Dis-Chem Better Rewards card at checkout to enter. Separate qualifying purchases can earn further entries.
Complete your purchase and swipe by 23:59 on 31 December 2026; keep your contact details current.

competitions.title: Powerade Rugby World Cup 2027 Trip Competition
competitions.summary: Buy two participating promotional Powerade 500ml PET products and enter via WhatsApp for a chance to win one of four Rugby World Cup 2027 trips for a winner and companion to Australia.
competitions.prizeName: Four Rugby World Cup 2027 Australia experiences for a winner and companion
competitions.eligibility: South African citizens and permanent residents aged 18+ living in South Africa, with valid identification. Entrants and companions must already hold qualifying valid South African passports at entry. Promoter-related parties, participating retailer employees and winners of any promoter competition in the previous six months are excluded.
entrySteps: Before buying, check your eligibility and ensure both you and your nominated companion already hold valid South African passports with at least six months validity after the proposed return date.
Buy two participating promotional Powerade Springboks Edition 500ml PET or Champions Edition 500ml PET products from a participating store displaying the campaign posters.
Scan the on-pack QR code, or send Coke to 087 133 0080 on WhatsApp. Complete registration, accept the terms and choose whether to receive marketing.
Upload a photo of your qualifying till slip and keep the original. Only the original purchaser may enter; use a new slip each time, up to three entries per day and 50 overall.

competitions.title: Win R500 with five qualifying GoTyme app transactions
competitions.summary: Win R500 with five qualifying GoTyme app transactions. Bank account and five qualifying app transactions required. Closes 2026-12-31.
competitions.prizeName: R500 in the monthly bank draw
competitions.eligibility: SA citizen residents over 18 with an active qualifying account. See the full restrictions below.
entrySteps: Complete at least five qualifying GoTyme app transactions during the campaign. Eligible types include electricity, airtime, EFT, PayShap and specified deposit/withdrawal transactions. Qualifying participants enter automatically; lottery purchases are not required.
Eligible banking account and transactions required; normal transaction charges may apply.

competitions.title: JWD Giveaway: Win a R10,000 Website
competitions.summary: South African adults representing a business or organisation can enter JWD’s free website giveaway. Complete the Facebook, Instagram and form steps for a chance to win an agreed website scope worth up to R10,000.
competitions.prizeName: Website design/build services up to R10,000
competitions.eligibility: South African residents aged 18+ who own, run or are authorised to represent a business or organisation, including one about to start. JWD staff, agents, suppliers and specified family/partners are excluded.
entrySteps: Like the official competition announcement linked on JWD’s page and follow the JWD Facebook page.
Follow JWD on Instagram using the official page link.
Complete the entry form, including business details and your social usernames, and accept the rules. All three steps are mandatory; submitting only the form does not qualify.
Submit during 12 October–31 December. One entry per email address counts. Sharing and the separate marketing checkbox are optional.
Check email and phone after the 12 January 2027 announcement; a winner who does not respond within 14 days can be replaced.

competitions.title: Tropika at Engen: Win a Réunion Trip for Two
competitions.summary: Buy two participating Tropika products at a participating Engen store and complete the official QR/WhatsApp entry for a chance to win product prizes or a Réunion Island trip for two advertised at R70,000.
competitions.prizeName: Réunion Island trip for two or scheduled product prizes
competitions.eligibility: South African citizens permanently resident in South Africa with a valid 13-digit ID number. Age 18+ or, for younger entrants, necessary parent/legal guardian assistance under clause 3.1.3. Staff, related family and suppliers involved in the campaign are excluded. Travel documents and entry requirements apply to both travellers.
entrySteps: Read Clover’s full campaign rules, participating-product list and travel requirements, then confirm your Engen store participates.
Buy two participating Tropika products during 1 October–31 December. Keep the original till slip and relevant product barcodes.
Scan the official promotional QR code and follow the prompts to the Tropika Island of Treasure WhatsApp entry route on +27 77 606 9063. Complete all requested entry fields.
Each extra entry needs a separate qualifying purchase. Keep proof until verification is complete; one person may win only once, including the grand prize.

If notified, respond immediately. Rules mention both 24-hour and 48-hour receipt deadlines: use the shorter 24-hour window and confirm with the organiser. Check prize-specific delivery and travel instructions.

competitions.title: Writers of the Future 2027 First Quarter
competitions.summary: Submit an original speculative-fiction story free to the first quarter of Writers of the Future 2027. Quarterly prizes are US$1,000, US$750 and US$500.
competitions.prizeName: Up to US$1,000 in the quarterly writing awards
competitions.eligibility: New and amateur writers worldwide, including South Africans, subject to the rules’ professional-publication limits. English-language prose only.
entrySteps: Check the detailed amateur eligibility rules before preparing your story.

Prepare one original unpublished speculative-fiction prose story of fewer than 17,000 words. Double-space it, number the pages and remove your name and contact information from the manuscript. AI-generated content is excluded.
Follow the official Writer Contest entry button to the submission portal and submit before 23:59 PST on 31 December 2026 (09:59 SAST on 1 January 2027).

competitions.title: Sony World Photography Awards 2027 Single Image Competition
competitions.summary: Enter up to three photographs free in Sony’s 2027 Single Image competition. The overall winner receives US$5,000 and Sony equipment. Closes 5 January 2027.
competitions.prizeName: US$5,000 and Sony photography equipment
competitions.eligibility: Worldwide, including South Africa; under-16 entrants need parent or guardian consent. Photos must have been taken in 2026.
entrySteps: Choose a category through the official Single Image page and create or sign into the entry account.
Read the rules and upload original photographs taken in 2026; use the free allowance of up to three images.
Submit before 16:00 GMT / 18:00 SAST on 5 January 2027.

competitions.title: DocTalk: Win a 2026 Suzuki S-Presso
competitions.summary: Win a 2026 Suzuki S-Presso through DocTalk’s app competition. No purchase is required; app entry confirmation is essential. Includes the promoter’s dated email clarification.
competitions.prizeName: One 2026 Suzuki S-Presso 1.0
competitions.eligibility: South African citizens or permanent residents aged 18+ at entry, with a valid South African ID or permanent residence permit. DocTalk confirmed by email on 15 October 2026 that both new and existing users are eligible. Promoter-related parties, specified relatives and people administering the competition are excluded.
entrySteps: Read the official competition rules and the dated promoter clarification on this page. The public entry wording has not yet been aligned with that clarification.

Download the official DocTalk ZA app using the Google Play or Apple App Store links on the campaign page. New users register; existing users sign in. Complete the account details requested by DocTalk.
Open the competition in the app and explicitly confirm your entry to receive your entry ticket. An account registration on its own does not complete the confirmed competition-entry step.

Optionally share your unique referral code with friends or family. DocTalk says you can earn up to 50 additional tickets when those people download and register using that code. Referrals are not required for the initial entry.
Check that the app records your competition entry before the closing time. If it does not, contact DocTalk through its official competition page.

competitions.title: Coca-Cola Returnables: Win Grocery Vouchers
competitions.summary: Buy a participating promotional returnable bottle with a unique code and enter on WhatsApp for grocery and smaller voucher prizes. Purchase required; the main grocery prize is R25,000 in total, not a monthly payment.
competitions.prizeName: 124 R25,000 grocery-voucher bundles and smaller voucher prizes
competitions.eligibility: SA citizens/permanent residents aged 18+ with valid identification; location, related-party and previous-winner exclusions apply.
entrySteps: Buy a participating promotional returnable product listed in Annexure A of the official rules. Check that the pack carries a valid 10-character unique code; not every product has one.
Scan the promotional QR code or send Hi to 082 508 9260 on WhatsApp. Follow the official registration prompts, provide your own name and surname, and accept the terms.
Make your marketing choice; receiving direct marketing can be declined. Enter the unique pack code through the WhatsApp process.
Complete entry by 23:59 South African time on 31 January 2027. Each code is valid once; additional entries require separate valid codes.

competitions.title: Schweppes Made Social competition 2026
competitions.summary: Schweppes Made Social offers VIP experiences, double tickets and R500 vouchers after buying two qualifying promotional products and uploading a receipt. It closes on 31 January 2027 at 23:59.
competitions.prizeName: Five VIP experiences, 26 double tickets and 3,000 R500 vouchers
competitions.eligibility: South African citizens or permanent residents aged 18 or older, physically in South Africa, with accepted ID or passport; promoter exclusions apply.
entrySteps: Buy two participating promotional products and keep the original receipt; check Annexure A and campaign packaging before buying.
Scan the promotional QR code or send Schweppes to the official WhatsApp number 087 133 0081.
Register with the required details and upload the qualifying receipt.
Use each receipt once. The cap is three new receipts per day and 50 receipts over the campaign.
Read the verification and prize-fulfilment conditions. Event dates and arrangements remain subject to the promoter’s rules.

competitions.title: Telkom Datanaire Tap2Win: Cash and Voucher Prizes
competitions.summary: Qualifying Telkom customers can enter the Summer cash draw and Tap2Win rewards campaign. R500 million is the advertised overall pool; cash prizes are R10,000 each. Purchase or contract activity is required.
competitions.prizeName: R10,000 cash prizes and Tap2Win rewards
competitions.entryMethod: Qualifying Purchase or Contract and Tap2Win Opt-in
competitions.eligibility: Eligible Telkom customers aged 18+ with SA ID/passport; qualifying activity, correct RICA details and account-in-good-standing conditions apply.
entrySteps: Read the current Summer Campaign rules. You must be an eligible Telkom customer aged 18+ with valid SA ID or passport; related-party exclusions apply.

For prepaid mobile, recharge or buy a qualifying bundle worth at least R29. Mobile contract customers can qualify through a new contract, upgrade or qualifying R29 recharge/bundle activity, as specified in the rules.
For Tap2Win rewards, opt in or register through *180#, *123#, the MyTelkom app or Telkom’s website and follow the play prompts. Do not assume purchase alone completes Tap2Win registration.
Fibre customers qualify for the separate Summer cash draw by subscribing to or renewing a Fibre contract. Do not assume the mobile Tap2Win play route applies to Fibre.
Complete qualifying activity by midnight ending 31 January 2027. Keep your RICA/account details current and check your Telkom notifications for entry, reward and expiry instructions.

competitions.title: Win grocery vouchers for you and your champion with Algoa FM
competitions.summary: Win grocery vouchers for you and your champion with Algoa FM. No purchase stated; messaging data costs apply. Closes 2027-02-25.
competitions.prizeName: A R1,500 grocery voucher each for you and your nominee
competitions.eligibility: 18+, SA citizenship, a bank account and residence in the station broadcast area. See the full restrictions below.
entrySteps: Send CHAMPION by WhatsApp or Telegram to 061 794 0940 with your name, town, nominee’s details and story. Selected entries must be reachable by phone and the nominee must be verified.
No purchase stated; messaging data costs apply.

competitions.title: SA Guide-Dogs Suzuki Across Car Raffle 2026
competitions.summary: Buy a R150 SA Guide-Dogs car-raffle ticket for a chance to win a Suzuki Across Auto and a Dinokeng safari package while supporting the association's assistance-dog services.
competitions.prizeName: One Suzuki Across Auto plus a two-night self-catering Dinokeng Game Reserve safari for four people, a guided Big 5 game drive, a R1,000 dining voucher and a cheetah-monitoring experience.
competitions.eligibility: The official rules exclude staff and board members of the association and their spouses or partners, children, parents and siblings. The rules do not state a minimum age or broader geographic restriction; identity is required to claim the prize.
entrySteps: Purchase one or more R150 raffle tickets through the official SA Guide-Dogs website. Each ticket gives one entry. EFT entries close at midnight on 3 March 2027 and website entries close at 13:00 on 7 March 2027.
Use the official website by 13:00 on 7 March 2027; EFT entries close earlier at midnight on 3 March 2027.

competitions.title: Nedbank Money AppVenture Competition
competitions.summary: Nedbank Money AppVenture gives eligible Nedbank personal banking clients a monthly chance to win an adventure experience worth up to R20,000. The qualifying action is logging in to the Nedbank Money app at least 20 times in a month.
competitions.prizeName: Adventure experience worth up to R20,000
competitions.eligibility: This is limited to qualifying Nedbank personal banking clients with Money app access and accounts in good standing.
entrySteps: Confirm you are an eligible Nedbank personal banking client with the Money app registered.
Log in to the Nedbank Money app at least 20 times during a calendar month in the competition period.
Keep your Nedbank account in good standing as required by the official terms.
Check the official terms for monthly draw and winner-contact conditions before relying on an entry.

competitions.title: Nedbank Appventure With Us Competition
competitions.summary: Eligible Nedbank personal-banking clients who log into the Money app at least 20 times in a month can win a monthly adventure or shopping experience worth up to R20,000.
competitions.prizeName: Monthly adventure, getaway or shopping experience worth up to R20,000
competitions.eligibility: South African citizens aged 18 or older who are natural-person Nedbank personal-banking clients with an eligible active account in good standing and a registered Nedbank Money app. Certain client categories are excluded under the terms.
entrySteps: Be an eligible Nedbank personal-banking client with an active account in good standing and register for the Nedbank Money app.
Log into the Nedbank Money app at least 20 times during a calendar month in the competition period.
A qualifying client receives an entry into that month's recorded draw; each winner chooses an eligible adventure or voucher option worth up to R20,000.

competitions.title: 1Life Winning Wednesday Cash Competition
competitions.summary: 1Life runs Winning Wednesday as a weekly social-media competition with a R2,000 cash prize. Entrants follow the relevant 1Life social page and comment the answer to the competition question on the post.
competitions.prizeName: R2,000 cash weekly prize
competitions.eligibility: Entrants should confirm the current social post and official 1Life terms before commenting.
entrySteps: Open the official 1Life Winning Wednesday terms page and find the relevant weekly social post.
Follow the 1Life social media page where you are entering.
Comment the answer to the question in the comment section of the competition post.
Enter once per person per week and wait for the weekly random draw.
